### Everyday Fitness & Longevity

- [Getting back to exercise after a break](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/fitness-and-longevity/getting-back-to-exercise-after-a-break): When you start moving again after months or years off, a sick spell, a new baby or a busy stretch. *39 checks, 9 Must*
- [Starting a strength training routine](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/fitness-and-longevity/starting-a-strength-training-routine): When you are about to start lifting or bodyweight training, or a program has run out and you need a new one. *36 checks, 8 Must*
- [Setting up eating around your training](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/fitness-and-longevity/setting-up-eating-around-your-training): When you start training regularly and wonder whether your eating supports your energy, your recovery and your weight goal. *38 checks, 7 Must*
- [Setting up Zone 2 cardio training](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/fitness-and-longevity/setting-up-zone-2-cardio-training): When you want to add easy endurance work and need to know how hard, how long and how to tell you are in the zone. *26 checks, 6 Must*
- [Sleeping badly and waking up tired](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/fitness-and-longevity/sleeping-badly-and-waking-up-tired): When you wake up unrefreshed for days or weeks, struggle to fall asleep, or keep waking in the night. *36 checks, 8 Must*
- [Trying intermittent fasting](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/fitness-and-longevity/trying-intermittent-fasting): When you want to try a daily eating window or longer fasts and set it up without hurting training or sleep. *44 checks, 9 Must*
- [Planning your weekly training mix](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/fitness-and-longevity/planning-your-weekly-training-mix): When you sit down to fit strength, easy cardio, intervals and rest into a real week around work and family. *28 checks, 8 Must*
- [Starting a new habit](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/habits-and-focus/starting-a-new-habit) (from Build Better Habits & Focus)

### Mindfulness & Stress Mastery

- [Starting a daily meditation practice](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/mindfulness-and-stress/starting-a-daily-meditation-practice): You want meditation to become a daily thing, either for the first time or after the last attempt quietly faded out. *31 checks, 7 Must*
- [Getting ready for a stressful event](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/mindfulness-and-stress/getting-ready-for-a-stressful-event): A known hard thing is coming: an exam, interview, surgery, presentation, court date or big conversation, days or weeks away. *40 checks, 7 Must*
- [Calming down fast when stress spikes](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/mindfulness-and-stress/calming-down-fast-when-stress-spikes): Your heart is pounding, breath is short and thinking narrows, before or during a meeting, exam, call or argument, and you need to settle. *30 checks, 5 Must*
- [Stressed all the time, can't switch off](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/mindfulness-and-stress/stressed-all-the-time-cant-switch-off): Stress no longer comes and goes: you wake up tense, cannot unwind in the evening, and rest days do not feel restful. *44 checks, 9 Must*
- [Getting through an overwhelming emotional moment](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/mindfulness-and-stress/getting-through-an-overwhelming-emotional-moment): A feeling is so strong you want to lash out, drink, binge or do something you will regret, and it cannot be fixed now. *34 checks, 6 Must*
- [Restless or uneasy during meditation](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/mindfulness-and-stress/restless-or-uneasy-during-meditation): Sits leave you more agitated than before: the mind races nonstop, the body fidgets, or fear, panic or old memories come up. *42 checks, 7 Must*
- [Bringing mindfulness into a busy day](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/mindfulness-and-stress/bringing-mindfulness-into-a-busy-day): Formal sits are happening, or not, but the rest of the day still runs on autopilot and stress. *30 checks, 6 Must*
- [Being hard on yourself after a setback](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/applied-positive-psychology/being-hard-on-yourself-after-a-setback) (from Applied Positive Psychology & Wellbeing)
- [Sleeping badly and waking up tired](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/fitness-and-longevity/sleeping-badly-and-waking-up-tired) (from Everyday Fitness & Longevity)
- [Conversation turning heated or hostile](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/effective-communication/conversation-turning-heated-or-hostile) (from Communicating with Impact)

### New Parent: Pregnancy to First Year

- [Getting ready for the birth](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/new-parent-first-year/getting-ready-for-the-birth): Third trimester, when you want the practical side of labor, the hospital stay and the first days home sorted before it starts. *41 checks, 8 Must*
- [First weeks home with a newborn](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/new-parent-first-year/first-weeks-home-with-a-newborn): The day you bring the baby home and through the first weeks, when every feed, diaper and color change raises a question. *45 checks, 8 Must*
- [Setting up safe sleep for a baby](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/new-parent-first-year/setting-up-safe-sleep-for-a-baby): Before the birth when setting up where the baby sleeps, and again when the baby starts rolling, travels, or sleeps somewhere new. *38 checks, 9 Must*
- [Healing your body after birth](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/new-parent-first-year/healing-your-body-after-birth): The weeks after the birth, when you are bleeding, sore or stitched and unsure what is normal healing and what needs a call. *45 checks, 9 Must*
- [Low mood or anxiety after the baby](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/new-parent-first-year/low-mood-or-anxiety-after-the-baby): When sadness, worry, rage or scary thoughts after the birth are not lifting, and you or your partner wonder if it is more than tiredness. *34 checks, 6 Must*
- [Breastfeeding hurting or supply worries](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/new-parent-first-year/breastfeeding-hurting-or-supply-worries): When feeds hurt, the baby never seems satisfied, or you worry you are not making enough milk, often in the early weeks. *43 checks, 9 Must*
- [Baby crying and won't settle](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/new-parent-first-year/baby-crying-and-wont-settle): When the baby has been crying for a long time, nothing you try works, and you are not sure if something is wrong. *42 checks, 8 Must*
- [Sleep training a baby](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/new-parent-first-year/sleep-training-a-baby): When months of broken nights are wearing you down and you are deciding whether, when and how to teach the baby to fall asleep alone. *41 checks, 9 Must*
- [Childproofing the home for a toddler](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/toddler-years/childproofing-the-home) (from The Toddler Years (1 to 5))
- [Worried about a missed milestone](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/toddler-years/worried-about-a-missed-milestone) (from The Toddler Years (1 to 5))
- [Choosing a daycare or preschool](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/toddler-years/choosing-daycare-or-preschool) (from The Toddler Years (1 to 5))

### Personal Finance Foundations

- [Building a budget you will keep](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/personal-finance-foundations/building-a-budget-you-will-keep): When you start tracking your money, change jobs or move, or your old budget stopped matching how you really spend. *40 checks, 9 Must*
- [Making a plan to pay off debt](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/personal-finance-foundations/making-a-plan-to-pay-off-debt): When card or loan balances stop shrinking, after a windfall, or when you decide to get out of debt for good. *35 checks, 9 Must*
- [Sizing and keeping a cash cushion](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/personal-finance-foundations/sizing-and-keeping-an-emergency-fund): When you set up your first cash cushion, after you dip into it, or when your rent, bills or household change. *39 checks, 9 Must*
- [Checking your insurance coverage](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/personal-finance-foundations/checking-your-insurance-coverage): When you marry, have a child, buy a home or car, change jobs, or a renewal or open enrollment arrives. *45 checks, 9 Must*
- [Setting up your retirement accounts](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/personal-finance-foundations/setting-up-your-retirement-accounts): When you start a job, become eligible for a plan, open an IRA or HSA, or realize you never checked your elections. *40 checks, 9 Must*
- [Building your first investment portfolio](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/personal-finance-foundations/building-your-first-investment-portfolio): When you have savings beyond your emergency fund and want to start investing, or you open a brokerage account for the first time. *40 checks, 9 Must*
- [Saving for a home or big goal](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/personal-finance-foundations/saving-for-a-home-or-big-goal): When you set a target like a down payment, wedding, car or sabbatical a few years out and need a plan to reach it. *37 checks, 9 Must*
- [Covering a big unexpected expense](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/personal-finance-foundations/covering-a-big-unexpected-expense): When a car repair, medical bill, vet visit or home fix lands and the cash to pay it is not clearly there. *29 checks, 9 Must*
- [Deciding where your next dollar goes](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/personal-finance-foundations/deciding-where-your-next-dollar-goes): When money is left after bills, a raise or bonus lands, or you cannot tell whether to save, invest or pay debt. *27 checks, 9 Must*

### The Toddler Years (1 to 5)

- [Toddler tantrums and meltdowns](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/toddler-years/toddler-tantrums-and-meltdowns): Your child melts down often, the same triggers keep coming back, or one meltdown just went badly and you want a plan. *43 checks, 9 Must*
- [Potty training a toddler](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/toddler-years/potty-training-a-toddler): You are thinking about starting potty training, have just started, or training has stalled or slid back after a good start. *44 checks, 8 Must*
- [Picky eating and mealtime battles](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/toddler-years/picky-eating-and-mealtime-battles): Meals have become a fight, the list of foods your child accepts keeps shrinking, or you are worried they are not eating enough. *40 checks, 9 Must*
- [Childproofing the home for a toddler](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/toddler-years/childproofing-the-home): Your child has started walking or climbing, you moved house, or a near miss showed you something you had not covered. *44 checks, 9 Must*
- [Setting a family screen time plan](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/toddler-years/family-screen-time-plan): Screen use has crept up, turning it off ends in tears, or you want rules in place before it becomes a habit. *41 checks, 8 Must*
- [Choosing a daycare or preschool](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/toddler-years/choosing-daycare-or-preschool): You need care to start in the coming months, you are touring places, or the current setting is not working and you are switching. *45 checks, 9 Must*
- [Siblings fighting and rivalry](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/toddler-years/siblings-fighting): Your children fight daily, an older child is rough with a younger one, or jealousy has flared since a new baby arrived. *43 checks, 8 Must*
- [Worried about a missed milestone](https://www.cheatgrid.com/checklists/toddler-years/worried-about-a-missed-milestone): Your child is not talking, walking or playing like others their age, a carer raised a concern, or a checkup flagged something. *41 checks, 9 Must*
